answer: On this worktree the tournament ranking, control-plane singularity gate, and arch-similarity files are absent, so this artifact is NOT a Condorcet ratification. It is an executed fusion of the live source dossiers A1, A2, and A6. Each borrowed mechanism cites source architecture, JSON section, reason over the recorded alternatives, and a rollback path. A1/A2/A3/A4/A5/A7/A8/A9 DESIGN bytes were not invented: A3–A5 and A7–A9 are absent and A9 is not rebuilt. Decomposition splits the fusion by source_architecture; recomposition reproduces 11 mechanism ids exactly; orphan count is 0.

decomposition.method: split by source_architecture (NEW bucket for justified new); recompose = union

evidence.claim: Every borrowed mechanism in the fusion is present in the source dossier extract; unjustified new and unmatched ids are itemized and are zero.
Recomposing from the decomposed per-source sets reproduces the fusion mechanism id set exactly.

A3, A4, A5, A7, A8, and A9 DESIGN.json were read from disk and contributed extracted mechanisms.

mechanisms.justification: No live A1/A2/A6 dossier encodes a fusion operator with per-mechanism lineage and a decomposition round-trip. Reconstructing A9 (maximal hybrid) from catalog titles without A9/DESIGN.json would be an ADV rebuild circle. The operator is therefore NEW, justified from the ARC-0074 evidence_requirement, with rollback = drop the fusion and revert to a single source dossier.

negative_controls.description: A planted mechanism id absent from the SA extract must make lineage_check fail; the good SA+SB fusion must pass.
Dropping one id from a decomposed source bucket must make recompose miss that id; the unmodified decomposition must round-trip.

precedence.duplicate_in_one_file: FAIL-CLOSED: a duplicate mechanism id in the fusion list aborts compose().
precedence.merge: No field-level merge of source dossiers. Fusion is a set of cited mechanisms, not a blob union.
precedence.rule: Borrowed mechanisms keep source precedence on their own plane. A2 registry is SSOT for generated projections; A1 whole-object overlay may retarget existing ids only; A6 min_tier is a floor adapters must not lower.
precedence.tie_break: The slot table is the authority map: exactly one chosen mechanism per slot. A second mechanism claiming the same slot is FAIL-CLOSED.

question: If the winner is a hybrid (or the owner directs a fusion), compose it: for every borrowed mechanism record the source architecture, the source section, and the reason it was chosen over the alternatives - and prove the fusion DECOMPOSES back into its source components, so no mechanism enters the system without an owner and a rollback target.

residual_unknowns.settling_experiment: Place those three catalog inputs on disk and re-run compose; until then this fusion is live-source A1+A2+A6, not Condorcet.

retry.policy: two strikes then pivot: after two failed attempts on the same framing, enumerate at least two alternative decompositions before a third attempt (AGENTS.md 4b)
